name: Chief Executive Officer
description: Leads the organisation and holds overall accountability for strategy, performance and governance.
purpose: Ensure sustainable business success and effective governance, risk and compliance oversight.
accountabilities: Corporate strategy; overall performance; governance; risk appetite; regulatory accountability.
responsibilities: Set strategic direction; approve key policies and priorities; oversee executive management; ensure adequate resources.
decision_making_powers: Final executive authority within delegated board powers; approves major strategic, financial and risk decisions.
interfaces: Board, executive management, key customers, regulators, shareholders and external stakeholders.

name: Chief Finance Officer
description: Leads financial management, planning, reporting and financial control.
purpose: Ensure financial stability, transparency and effective financial governance.
accountabilities: Financial reporting; budgeting; liquidity; financial controls; tax and financial compliance.
responsibilities: Manage financial planning and reporting; oversee accounting and controls; monitor financial risks.
decision_making_powers: Approves financial decisions and expenditures within delegated authority.
interfaces: CEO, executive management, Finance, Risk, Compliance, auditors and financial institutions.

name: Chief Information Officer
description: Leads information technology strategy and IT service delivery.
purpose: Ensure technology supports business objectives securely, reliably and efficiently.
accountabilities: IT strategy; IT governance; IT operations; applications; infrastructure; technology investments.
responsibilities: Define IT priorities; oversee IT services and projects; ensure availability and performance of IT capabilities.
decision_making_powers: Approves IT architecture, investments and operational priorities within delegated authority.
interfaces: CEO, CTO, CISO, business functions, IT teams and service providers.

name: Chief Technology Officer
description: Leads technology strategy, architecture, engineering and technological innovation.
purpose: Ensure technology solutions are scalable, effective and aligned with business and product strategy.
accountabilities: Technology architecture; engineering strategy; innovation; product technology; technical standards.
responsibilities: Define technology roadmap; oversee development and architecture; evaluate emerging technologies; ensure technical quality.
decision_making_powers: Approves technology architecture, engineering standards and technical solution decisions.
interfaces: CEO, CIO, CISO, Product, Engineering and technology partners.

name: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Leads the organisation's information and cyber security programme.
purpose: Protect information, systems and services against security threats while supporting business objectives.
accountabilities: Information security strategy; security governance; cyber risk; security controls; security incidents.
responsibilities: Define security policies; oversee security risks and controls; monitor threats; coordinate security incidents and awareness.
decision_making_powers: Approves security standards, security exceptions and treatment recommendations within delegated authority.
interfaces: CEO/CIO, Risk, Compliance, IT, Data Protection, business owners, auditors and regulators.

name: Chief Compliance Officer
description: Leads the organisation's compliance framework and regulatory compliance activities.
purpose: Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, standards and internal requirements.
accountabilities: Compliance framework; regulatory obligations; compliance monitoring; ethics; compliance reporting.
responsibilities: Identify obligations; establish compliance controls; monitor compliance; advise management; coordinate regulatory matters.
decision_making_powers: Determines compliance requirements and escalates material compliance breaches; approves exceptions where authorised.
interfaces: CEO, Legal, Risk, Internal Audit, business functions and regulators.

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: Leads enterprise-wide risk management and risk governance.
purpose: Ensure significant risks are identified, assessed, monitored and managed within approved risk appetite.
accountabilities: Enterprise risk framework; risk appetite; risk reporting; risk oversight; risk culture.
responsibilities: Define risk methodology; oversee risk assessments; challenge risk owners; consolidate and report key risks.
decision_making_powers: Sets risk management requirements and escalates risks outside approved tolerance.
interfaces: CEO, Board, CISO, CFO, Compliance, business functions and Risk Owners.

name: IT Manager
description: Manages day-to-day IT services, systems and infrastructure.
purpose: Ensure reliable, secure and efficient operation of the organisation's IT environment.
accountabilities: IT operations; infrastructure; support; system availability; IT service providers.
responsibilities: Operate IT services; manage incidents and changes; maintain systems; coordinate vendors; implement technical controls.
decision_making_powers: Makes operational IT decisions and approves changes within delegated authority.
interfaces: CIO/CTO, CISO, users, system owners and technology providers.

name: Compliance Manager
description: Manages operational compliance activities and regulatory requirements.
purpose: Ensure compliance obligations are understood, implemented and monitored.
accountabilities: Compliance requirements; compliance controls; monitoring; evidence; reporting.
responsibilities: Maintain regulatory requirements; perform compliance assessments; monitor controls; coordinate remediation.
decision_making_powers: Interprets operational compliance requirements and escalates significant issues.
interfaces: CCO, Legal, Risk, Process Owners, Control Owners and auditors.

name: Risk Manager
description: Coordinates and supports the organisation's risk management process.
purpose: Ensure risks are consistently identified, assessed, monitored and reported.
accountabilities: Risk register; risk methodology; risk assessments; risk reporting.
responsibilities: Facilitate risk assessments; maintain risk information; monitor treatment plans; support Risk Owners.
decision_making_powers: Challenges risk assessments and recommends treatment or escalation; does not normally accept risk for Risk Owners.
interfaces: CRO, Risk Owners, management, Compliance, Security and Internal Audit.

name: Data Protection / Privacy Officer
description: Oversees privacy and personal data protection requirements.
purpose: Ensure personal data is processed in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.
accountabilities: Privacy governance; data protection compliance; data subject rights; privacy risks.
responsibilities: Advise on privacy requirements; monitor compliance; support DPIAs; manage privacy incidents and requests.
decision_making_powers: Provides independent privacy advice and may escalate non-compliance as applicable.
interfaces: Management, Legal, Compliance, Security, HR, IT, Process Owners and regulators.

name: Quality Manager
description: Manages the quality management framework and continuous improvement activities.
purpose: Ensure processes and services meet defined quality requirements and improve continuously.
accountabilities: Quality management system; quality controls; audits; non-conformities; improvement.
responsibilities: Maintain quality processes; coordinate audits; track corrective actions; monitor quality indicators.
decision_making_powers: Approves quality procedures and corrective actions within delegated authority.
interfaces: Management, Process Owners, Control Owners, auditors and operational teams.

name: Business Continuity Manager
description: Coordinates business continuity and organisational resilience activities.
purpose: Ensure critical services can continue or recover following disruptions.
accountabilities: Business continuity framework; business impact analysis; continuity plans; exercises; recovery readiness.
responsibilities: Perform BIAs; maintain continuity plans; coordinate tests; monitor resilience actions; support crisis response.
decision_making_powers: Defines continuity requirements and recommends recovery priorities and escalation.
interfaces: Management, IT, Security, Risk, Process Owners and service providers.

name: HR Manager
description: Manages people-related processes and workforce governance.
purpose: Ensure effective and compliant management of employees throughout the employment lifecycle.
accountabilities: Recruitment; employment processes; employee records; training; HR compliance.
responsibilities: Manage onboarding/offboarding; maintain HR policies; coordinate training; support employee matters.
decision_making_powers: Makes HR decisions within employment policies and delegated authority.
interfaces: Management, Legal, Compliance, Security, Finance and employees.

name: Finance Manager
description: Manages operational financial processes, accounting and financial controls.
purpose: Ensure accurate and controlled execution of financial activities.
accountabilities: Accounting; financial controls; budgeting; payments; financial reporting.
responsibilities: Maintain financial records; execute controls; prepare reports; support audits and budgeting.
decision_making_powers: Approves financial transactions within delegated limits.
interfaces: CFO, Procurement, business functions, auditors and financial institutions.

name: Legal Manager / Legal Counsel
description: Provides legal advice and manages legal and contractual matters.
purpose: Protect the organisation's legal interests and ensure legal requirements are appropriately addressed.
accountabilities: Legal advice; contracts; legal obligations; disputes; legal risk.
responsibilities: Review contracts; advise on legal requirements; support negotiations; manage legal matters and external counsel.
decision_making_powers: Provides legal interpretation and approves legal positions within delegated authority.
interfaces: Management, Compliance, Procurement, HR, Data Protection and external counsel.

name: Procurement / Supplier Manager
description: Manages procurement and supplier relationships throughout the supplier lifecycle.
purpose: Ensure goods and services are sourced effectively and suppliers meet commercial, security and compliance requirements.
accountabilities: Supplier selection; contracting; supplier performance; procurement controls; third-party coordination.
responsibilities: Conduct sourcing; assess suppliers; coordinate due diligence; manage contracts and supplier reviews.
decision_making_powers: Selects or recommends suppliers and approves procurement decisions within delegated limits.
interfaces: Finance, Legal, Security, Compliance, business owners and suppliers.

name: Process Owner
description: Accountable for the design, operation and performance of an assigned business process.
purpose: Ensure the process achieves its objectives and complies with applicable requirements.
accountabilities: Process effectiveness; process risks; controls; performance; documentation.
responsibilities: Define and maintain process; monitor performance; address deficiencies; coordinate improvements and controls.
decision_making_powers: Approves process changes and accepts operational decisions within delegated authority.
interfaces: Management, Control Owners, Risk, Compliance, IT and process participants.

name: Control Owner
description: Accountable for the design, implementation and ongoing effectiveness of an assigned control.
purpose: Ensure the control adequately addresses its intended risk or requirement.
accountabilities: Control design; operation; evidence; effectiveness; remediation.
responsibilities: Maintain control description; ensure execution; provide evidence; monitor deficiencies; implement improvements.
decision_making_powers: Determines control operation and recommends changes; significant exceptions require appropriate approval.
interfaces: Process Owners, Risk Owners, Compliance, Security, auditors and control performers.

name: Internal Auditor
description: Independently assesses governance, risk management and control effectiveness.
purpose: Provide objective assurance and identify opportunities for improvement.
accountabilities: Audit planning; independent assurance; findings; audit reporting; follow-up.
responsibilities: Conduct audits; assess controls; document findings; issue recommendations; track remediation.
decision_making_powers: Determines audit conclusions and recommendations independently; does not own operational controls.
interfaces: Board/Audit Committee, management, Risk, Compliance, Control Owners and external auditors.

name: Contributor / Employee
description: Performs assigned activities and contributes information, evidence or responses.
purpose: Support operational, assessment and compliance activities relevant to assigned responsibilities.
accountabilities: Accuracy and timeliness of assigned work; compliance with applicable policies and procedures.
responsibilities: Complete assigned tasks; answer assessment questions; provide evidence; follow policies; report identified issues.
decision_making_powers: Makes routine decisions within assigned responsibilities; no broad management authority.
interfaces: Managers, Assessment Managers, Process Owners, Control Owners and colleagues.

name: External Contributor
description: External user who provides information or evidence for specifically assigned activities.
purpose: Enable controlled participation by suppliers, consultants, auditors or other external parties.
accountabilities: Accuracy and confidentiality of submitted information within assigned scope.
responsibilities: Complete assigned questions or tasks; provide evidence and comments; comply with access and confidentiality requirements.
decision_making_powers: Limited to assigned activities; no internal management authority.
interfaces: Assessment Manager, Supplier Manager, relevant business contact and other authorised users.
